_comment: Every public task on every platform and delegate. 'required' cells need a passing
row from this commit's pull-request CI; 'device' cells need one from physical hardware (the
manually dispatched device workflow, run for this commit or on main within 48 hours), and the
gate reports them as awaiting until one has run.
'pending: <step>' cells are planned; 'unsupported: <reason>' cells are Google's limits.
tool/coverage/gate.py enforces it; the vision and text packages' coverage matrix tests keep it honest.
